# Grademaxxing

> A private, read-only StudentVUE grade companion: grade trends, category math, what-if scores, attendance, documents, and school mail in one calm view. Official school records stay official; every estimate is clearly labeled as a simulation.

Grademaxxing connects to a district's StudentVUE portal using the student's existing account, reads the gradebook over HTTPS, and turns it into dated assignment trends, weighted-category math, and what-if simulations. It can never change school records, submit work, or send mail. Credentials are encrypted on the device and never stored on the server.

## Pages

- [Home](https://grademaxxing.app/): Product overview, feature tour, FAQ, and a preview of the gradebook
- [Log in](https://grademaxxing.app/login): Connect a StudentVUE account; the password is encrypted on-device and sent only over HTTPS
- [Privacy](https://grademaxxing.app/privacy): How credentials, sessions, local caches, and referrals are handled
- [Glossary](https://grademaxxing.app/glossary): Plain-language definitions for grading and StudentVUE terms
